issue.title: bob periods migrate dry-run sample_diff pairs lines by index instead of rendering a unified diff

task_type_fields.impact: Makes every bob periods migrate dry run that inserts or removes a line hard to review, which is the step the adoption runbooks rely on before -a.
task_type_fields.repro:
Root cause: `sample_diff(path, before, after)` in src/native/periods/migrate.rs (~line 940, unchanged since 5a1ccf59 on 2026-11-03) compares `before.lines()` and `after.lines()` by index. Any inserted or removed line shifts every later index, so each subsequent line prints as a `-old`/`+new` pair even though it did not change, and the 12-row cap is consumed by noise.

Repro: in a scratch vault with a daily note whose preamble holds `**Headline:** X`, run `bob periods migrate -f json` (dry run). `sample_diff` shows the frontmatter insertion followed by every shifted body line as removed and re-added, instead of a small hunk. bob-cli-nh.8 hit this while reviewing the live-vault adoption dry run on 2026-11-20 (note #10).

Fix: render a real unified diff with the already-depended-on `similar` crate (Cargo.toml `similar = "2"`), e.g. `similar::TextDiff::from_lines(before, after).unified_diff().context_radius(2).header(path, path)`, keeping the existing output cap and the JSON `sample_diff` string field; update any golden or test that pins the old shape.

issue.creation_reason: Reviewing the intentions adoption dry run (bob-cli-nh.8 note #10) showed the migrate sample diff is unreadable after any insertion; the defect predates that epic.
